premises: A Si-20Cr-20Fe silicide coating can be applied to MoNbTaTiW RHEA via a fused slurry method.
The silicide coating forms a double-layer structure (MSi2 outer, M5Si3 inner) that evolves into an outer oxide and inner silicide layer upon oxidation.
The coating effectively prevents oxidation of the MoNbTaTiW RHEA.
The oxide layer structure depends on oxidation temperature, implying a protective scale can form at high temperature.
